parts.label: Composite rest mass
parts.help: Positive rest mass scale m; composite internal energy is included.

parts.label: Outgoing velocity of the 4m particle
parts.help: Nontrivial elastic collision with momentum exchange; +x is the incoming direction. The unchanged-velocity no-exchange branch is not requested in this field.

parts.label: Outgoing velocity of the m particle
parts.help: Nontrivial elastic collision with momentum exchange; signed velocity along +x.

parts.label: Maximum heavy-particle deflection
parts.help: Same two outgoing rest masses, elastic two-body final state; enter degrees, not radians.

parts.label: Smallest photon separation angle
parts.help: Enter the result in the displayed unit, without a unit suffix.

parts.label: Largest photon separation angle
parts.help: Enter the result in the displayed unit, without a unit suffix.

parts.label: Maximum f₁
parts.help: All three photon energies are strictly positive; the other two may be collinear backwards. Constants m, c and h are positive.
